body:
Adds `research/ordinal-scores`: RPS (Brier on the CDF) for ordered verifier severity reports. Exact regret, distance-sensitive shift law (dε² vs Brier 2ε²), exact worst case, coarse-graining cost (half of Brier), threshold-error transfer, and the honest per-range limit. Stdlib-only, 7 tests passing, white paper, portfolio + README entries. MIT.
